## What's new

Internal hardening and tooling improvements. There are no user-visible changes
in this release, and nothing here changes how the application is used.

### Improved

- **Account changes now take effect immediately, even under load.** Disabling an
  account, changing a password, resetting one, or deleting a user already ended
  that person's other sessions straight away. Under a narrow combination of
  concurrent traffic, that could be delayed by a few seconds. It no longer can
  be.

- **The automated check that guards every API endpoint is more thorough — and
  now checks itself.** Every change to this project runs a check confirming that
  each API endpoint requires a signed-in user. That check could be misled into
  reporting an endpoint as protected when it was not. It now reads the code more
  carefully, and ships with its own test suite so that the check's correctness is
  verified on every run rather than assumed.

### Changed

- **The "connect a delivery provider" pop-up has been reworked internally** so it
  will keep working under the stricter browser security policy planned for a
  future release. Its behaviour is unchanged: it still reports success or
  failure, notifies the page that opened it, and closes itself.
